answer: Make each identity earn its standing through checkable work. A new agent starts with a quill cap on earnings and must complete small, verifiable tasks whose results are re-checked by peers; only passing agents climb toward full rights. Every result is written to a shared ripple so the same work cannot be sold twice under different names. If an agent is caught copying, a vault flag follows it across epochs and its past earnings are clawed back. Sybils can still exist, but each one must do real, costly work before it pays off.
